title: DC619 EEPROM - SAO++ edition
credit: Circuit: AND!XOR SAO reference design DC27/DC619-EEPROM_sao1.69bis (Apache-2.0), github.com/ANDnXOR/sao-reference-designs. Layout: SAO++
notes: BADGE POWER ONLY (recorded exception to the SAO++ standard): no coin cell, no switch.
SAO pin 1 (3.3 V) feeds the EEPROM directly. The LEDs are lit by the badge through GPIO1 / GPIO2.
U1: 24C02 in SOT-23-5, fixed I2C address 0x50, WP tied to GND (writable), as on the maker's schematic.
No pull-ups on SDA / SCL: the badge provides them.
Maker's schematic: R1 (GPIO1) -> D2, R2 (GPIO2) -> D1, both 4.7k; here 1.3k (shared part).
